groups.root_cause: The push re-reads mutable repository config after the final snapshot check, so changes made after validation take effect.
The delivery and land-queue push paths in repos.ts run git push with untrusted repository config (sshCommand, URL rewrites) that has not been isolated or sanitized.
The config validation is too strict and rejects harmless local settings such as user identity.
The integration tests use a default 5-second timeout that is too short for their subprocess-heavy work.
Rejection messages print the full config key names, which can expose credentials embedded in URL-scoped keys.
